objective.request: We're launching our app next week. Build me a launch-week social media plan for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X. I want channel-specific content formats, posting priorities and messaging recommendations based on current audience behaviour and engagement trends — not generic social media advice. Use what we already have and public research first, but if the evidence isn't actually available to us, don't guess.
objective.title: We're launching our app next week. Build me a launch-week…

outcome.intent: Produce an evidence-grounded, launch-week social media plan for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X that uses available company materials and public research, distinguishes verified audience insights from evidence gaps, and avoids unsupported claims.

levels.label: Evidence scoped
levels.statement: The available company materials and public research relevant to launch-week social performance are identified, with source dates, coverage, and limitations recorded; unavailable audience or engagement evidence is explicitly marked rather than inferred.

levels.label: Channel plan defined
levels.statement: A channel-specific plan exists for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X, covering content formats, posting priorities, and messaging recommendations tied to the evidence available for each channel.

levels.label: Launch-week ready
levels.statement: The plan is organized across the launch week, uses existing company assets where available, clearly separates evidence-backed recommendations from assumptions, and is sufficiently complete for the owner to execute without relying on generic or unsupported advice.

requirements.mustBeTrue: Relevant company materials and publicly available research on current audience behavior and engagement trends for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X have been identified and assessed, with source provenance, recency, applicability, verified findings, and evidence gaps explicitly recorded; unavailable evidence is not inferred.
requirements.title: Evidence scope established

requirements.mustBeTrue: Each of TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X has a defined launch-week planning basis that maps available verified evidence to suitable content formats, relative posting priorities, and messaging considerations without presenting unsupported claims as facts.
requirements.title: Channel plan basis defined

requirements.mustBeTrue: A practical launch-week social media plan is defined for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X, including channel-specific content formats, posting priorities, messaging recommendations, and timing or sequencing sufficient for execution; every audience-behavior or engagement-trend claim is supported by the scoped evidence or clearly labeled as unknown, and the plan explicitly distinguishes verified insights from evidence gaps.
requirements.title: Evidence-grounded launch-week social media plan delivered
